title: Arrest without warrant
question: What does Lagos State Traffic Law 2012 section 22 say about arrest without warrant?
shortAnswer: Lagos State Traffic Law 2012 s.22 — LASTMA/VIO may arrest without warrant for traffic offences: dangerous driving, obstruction, fake documents.
